SCRIPT W-Br - Hi, I'm Tina Mackin, from the television program Sunrise Scotland. I just received an e-mail with information on the musical that's opening next month, The Fields of Dumbarton. SCRIPT W-Br Good morning, new Catrin's Fitness staff. SCRIPT W-Am Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the Panecks Corporation's ten-year anniversary luncheon. We have had so many achievements: just this past year we sold our five millionth unit. That makes five million cars on the road today equipped with Panecks radios. As you might know, our president, Mr. Strohmeyer, has been in Japan all this month negotiating with Navasota Motors. SCRIPT M-Cn Thanks for attending this all-staff meeting today. First on the agenda is our new restaurant reservation app. Faster Now. We trave competition from other technology companies, but our app is the only one that specializes in business luncheons. You'll see that the app will allow the user not only to reserve a table but also to make menu choices in advance. That way, when people get to the restaurant, they won't have to wait long for their meal. Here's Johanna, our lead IT researcher, who'll describe the app specifications and show us how it works.

SCRIPT W-Am I called this meeting because next week this team is scheduled to begin installing windows in the new building on Bellevue Avenue. Originally, you were going to install the M-FIT on all floors. Our supplier just raised the price on those frames, so we had to change them. The new type, the M-25, has the same dimensions, but it's installed differently. I'll send a link to the supplier's Web site where you're going to sign up to watch a video demonstration on how to install this model. I know this is a last-minute request. Still, this way we'll stay on budget.

SCRIPT M-Au Thank you for calling Forest Apartments. Press one to speak to our on-site manager. All residents should be aware that next week we will start updating the laundry facilities in each of our buildings. While the work is going on, tenants will not be able to access the laundry facilities in their building. The Maple building will be first. Tenants of the Maple building may use the laundry room in any other building while their facilities are being renovated. Please note that new doors and locks will also be installed, so all tenants will need a new key. Please stop at the main office to pick that up.

SCRIPT W-Am This message is for Mr. Yun. I'm calling from the rental office. I received the signed contract, and as we confirmed earlier, your rental of the retail space here in the shopping center will begin on the first of October. There are a few more things. You need to schedule a city inspection before the electricity can be turned on. And the owner has agreed to your request to add a storage room, and construction will begin within the week. I think everything can be done by the first of October, and you can open your doors and welcome new customers.

SCRIPT M-Cn Greetings, Carsin's cashiers! Let's take a look at the coupon we just mailed out to rewards members this week. Our local rival, Gilroy's, has been offering a similar discount to its customers, and business there has been booming. So it's time we try something similar—but, of course, even better. Our discount offer is ten percent, while theirs is only five percent. Please spend some time looking over the four rules of use at the bottom. We may need to revisit the one about using multiple discounts. Our customers do love manufacturer coupons. We will monitor customer complaints.

SCRIPT M-Au Good morning. I hope you are settling in to your new offices here at Golden Glove Insurance Company. Let's plan something fun to get to know each other. On the wall, there's a list Of team-building activities. After this meeting, put a check mark next to the activity you want to do together next Friday afternoon. lt would be energizing and fun to use our volleyball court, but I shouldn't influence you! Please make your own choice, and we'll do the one with the most votes.

As my company's regional training manager, I am often making presentations to groups of people and rarely in the same place. I needed a portable projector to display what's on my computer screen, and the Veruvatron 800 is perfect because it is slim and light. I did quite a bit of research comparing different brands in terms of image resolution and other specifications. Many were comparable in terms of those specifications, but the Veruvatron 800 is especially easy to bring to all my presentations, and that is ultimately why I chose this one. One flaw is that both the power cord and the VGA cord are surprisingly short. I have needed to use an extension cord pretty much every time I use it, so be prepared to do the same.

- Horace Offerman

Is anybody interested in helping me develop the visual component of my presentation? Some pie charts and diagrams would make a big impact in the slideshow.

I am hoping that the commission accepts Ken Jansen's offer to buy the property, which is next to his land. He would expand his orchard and this would help maintain the rural nature of northern Sunner Valley.

Call for Entries: Annual Sustainability Competition

Sponsored by the League of New Zealand Builders

PURPOSE: The League of New Zealand Builders (LNZB) wants to recognize an individual whose contribution to a new construction features design innovations that are environmentally friendly. The winner will be featured at an on-site celebration and show guests and journalists around the finished building, explaining its environmental highlights.

ENTRANTS: Priority consideration will be given to members of the LNZB, but any professional builder who completes a project in New Zealand before 15 December of this year may apply. Go to the LNZB Web site for the submission form.

DUE DATE: All submissions are due by 15 December.

JUDGING PROCESS: The application and vetting process includes several steps. After screening the candidates, judges will choose semifinalists. Then a special panel will choose this year's recipient.

FOR MORE INFORMATION: Visit www.leagueofnewzealandbuilders.org.nz to learn more about the LNZB and past winners.

Rahotu Wins LNZB Prize

(17 March)-The League of New Zealand Builders (LNZB) yesterday announced that Maia Rahotu won this year's Sustainability Competition. Ms. Rahotu, whose work on building designs throughout New Zealand goes back many years, won the award for her design of the Rowan Community Centre. The centre utilized renewable and recycled materials throughout its construction. In April, Ms. Rahotu will be formally presented with the award during the ceremony at the centre; details will be announced soon. "It was a tough decision this year," said LNZB's director, Thomas Young. "All applicants chose materials that minimize environmental impact. But we were able to narrow the candidates to three top choices, each of whom was interviewed by our panel of experts."

Building components in the Rowan project were thoughtfully selected by Ms. Rahotu to minimize environmental impact, Young added. "However, what is exceptional about Ms. Rahotu's design is how well it harvests solar energy." According to experts at LNZB, her solar design generates a high surplus of electricity beyond the building's requirements. This surplus is transmitted to the region's power grid-in effect reducing strain on local energy production.

questions.stem: The additional training will help you become more ------ with RNV Laboratory's procedures.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "become familiar with" mang nghĩa là trở nên quen thuộc với điều gì đó. Các tính từ khác không đi với giới từ "with" trong ngữ cảnh này.

questions.stem: Reviews of employee performance are conducted ------ a quarterly basis.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "on a ... basis" (trên cơ sở/theo định kỳ) luôn đi kèm với giới từ "on". "On a quarterly basis" nghĩa là theo định kỳ hàng quý.

questions.stem: Concert venues routinely record------ to evaluate the success of their marketing campaigns.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ "record" cần một danh từ đóng vai trò tân ngữ. "Attendance" là danh từ chỉ số lượng người tham dự, phù hợp để đánh giá chiến dịch marketing.

questions.stem: The new contract must be signed and returned ------ any work can begin.
questions.explanation: Câu cần một liên từ chỉ thời gian phù hợp. "Before" (trước khi) hợp lý nhất vì hợp đồng phải ký xong thì công việc mới được phép bắt đầu.

questions.stem: The park’s maps ------ the difficulty level of each hiking trail.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ "The park's maps" là số nhiều, câu đang thiếu động từ chính ở thì hiện tại đơn. "Explain" là động từ nguyên mẫu phù hợp với chủ ngữ số nhiều.

questions.stem: Braley's Deli prides itself on its fresh ingredients and ------ customer service.
questions.explanation: Chọn tính từ phù hợp để miêu tả dịch vụ khách hàng. "Rapid" (nhanh chóng) là một đặc điểm tích cực thường dùng để quảng bá chất lượng dịch vụ.

questions.stem: The next technology coordination team meeting will be held ------ teleconference at 3:00 P.M. tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "by" được dùng để chỉ phương thức liên lạc hoặc hình thức thực hiện (by teleconference, by phone).

questions.stem: Weiss Landscaping has a ------ grasp on its client base because of its excellent customer service.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau mạo từ "a" và trước danh từ "grasp" nên cần một tính từ. Cụm "have a firm grasp on something" nghĩa là hiểu rõ hoặc nắm vững điều gì đó.

questions.stem: We add funds to our savings account ------ we can to ensure we have money on hand for unexpected expenses.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào nghĩa của câu, liên từ "whenever" (bất cứ khi nào) phù hợp nhất để chỉ sự thường xuyên của hành động tiết kiệm tiền.

questions.stem: Last year’s model of Rulster’s electric vehicle ------ at a significant discount.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ là vật (mẫu xe điện của năm ngoái) nên cần chia ở dạng bị động. "Is being offered" (đang được chào bán) là đáp án duy nhất đúng cấu trúc bị động phù hợp ngữ cảnh.

questions.stem: Freight trains are Choman Transport’s ------ method of shipping materials if time is not an important factor.
questions.explanation: Chọn tính từ phù hợp để mô tả phương thức vận chuyển. "Preferred method" là một cụm từ phổ biến mang nghĩa là "phương thức được ưu tiên/yêu thích".

questions.stem: In order to respond to customer concerns, the sales department has collected all the ------ that has been sent.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ "all the" cần một danh từ. "Correspondence" (thư từ giao dịch) là danh từ không đếm được, phù hợp để chỉ tất cả các loại thư từ khách hàng đã gửi.

questions.stem: Festival officials stored items that were left behind after the event until they could determine ------ owned them.
questions.explanation: Câu cần một đại từ quan hệ đóng vai trò chủ ngữ cho động từ "owned" trong mệnh đề phụ. "Who" được dùng để chỉ người sở hữu các món đồ bị bỏ lại.

questions.stem: Even though there were problems with traffic last year, officials have again ------ to hold the parade in the city center.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh, dù có vấn đề giao thông năm ngoái nhưng năm nay họ vẫn tiếp tục "decided" (quyết định) tổ chức lại tại địa điểm đó.

questions.stem: We will make arrangements for Ms. Tanaka’s ------ once we finalize the schedule for her tour of our corporate headquarters.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ sở hữu (Ms. Tanaka’s) cần một danh từ. "Arrival" là danh từ duy nhất trong các lựa chọn, tạo thành cụm "sự đến nơi của cô Tanaka".

questions.stem: Given the benefits it will provide, members of the community were ------ excited about the proposal for a new shopping center.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "understandably" (một cách dễ hiểu/có thể hiểu được) phù hợp để bổ nghĩa cho tính từ "excited", diễn tả tâm trạng hợp lý của cư dân trước những lợi ích của dự án.

questions.stem: Ultra Star Construction gained ------ savings by purchasing materials from different suppliers.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước danh từ "savings" nên cần một tính từ để bổ nghĩa. "Substantial" (đáng kể) thường đi kèm với các danh từ chỉ tiền bạc hoặc sự tiết kiệm.

questions.stem: Research project managers at Envira Hospital often hire external ------ with extensive experience in their fields.
questions.explanation: Trong ngữ cảnh bệnh viện và dự án nghiên cứu, việc thuê các chuyên gia bên ngoài được gọi là "consultants" (tư vấn viên/chuyên gia tư vấn).

questions.stem: Ms. Kwan reported that she is ------ finished with her report pending receipt of final client reviews.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "almost" (gần như) đi với "finished" để chỉ một trạng thái sắp hoàn thành, chỉ còn chờ đợi một bước cuối cùng (receipt of reviews).

questions.stem: Based on sales reports from the past three months, the ------ seems to be that our newest products are gaining popularity.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào dữ liệu từ báo cáo bán hàng trong 3 tháng qua, từ "trend" (xu hướng) là danh từ phù hợp nhất để mô tả việc sản phẩm đang dần phổ biến hơn.

questions.stem: Newport Hills Property Developers are hiring ------contractors to build a state-of-the-art water filtration system.
questions.explanation: Đứng trước danh từ "contractors" (nhà thầu) cần một tính từ. "Qualified" (đủ năng lực/trình độ) là tính từ phù hợp để mô tả các nhà thầu đáp ứng yêu cầu kỹ thuật cao.

questions.stem: ------ to Alpine Climber magazine include Karl Saenz and Holli Bergits, two of Europe's best photographers.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ của câu là những nhiếp ảnh gia đóng góp nội dung cho tạp chí, nên danh từ "contributors" (người đóng góp/cộng tác viên) là chính xác nhất.

questions.stem: Notes on the ------ of the merger of LN Bank and East Way Bank will be included in the meeting minutes.

questions.stem: Ms. Ahmad asked that we complete our assignments ------ so that she can include them in her monthly budget report today.

questions.stem: The new operations manager was surprised that the directors wanted cost estimates even for minor tasks ------ labeling.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "such as" được dùng để đưa ra ví dụ. Trong ngữ cảnh này, "labeling" (việc dán nhãn) là một ví dụ cụ thể cho "minor tasks" (các đầu việc nhỏ).

questions.stem: After additional research, Mr. Haines has ------ his report on the prevalence of migratory birds in the region.
questions.explanation: Sau khi thực hiện nghiên cứu bổ sung, hành động phù hợp nhất đối với một bản báo cáo là "revised" (chỉnh sửa/xem xét lại) để cập nhật thông tin mới.

questions.stem: According to the publisher, Clark Lee’s book is selling well ------ a few recent negative reviews.
questions.explanation: Câu mang nghĩa nhượng bộ: cuốn sách vẫn bán chạy "despite" (mặc dù) có một vài đánh giá tiêu cực gần đây. Sau "despite" là một cụm danh từ.

questions.stem: Employees in the Kano Insurance personnel department must be able to analyze every application ------.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "objectively" (một cách khách quan) bổ nghĩa cho động từ "analyze", diễn tả yêu cầu đánh giá đơn ứng tuyển không dựa trên định kiến cá nhân.

questions.stem: Why does Mr. Eiling start the text-message chain?

options.text: To tell Ms. Chin that she missed a work shift
To ask someone to cover a work shift
To extend an invitation to a special event
To ask for a ride to work

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: come into the shop to work tonight (đến cửa hàng làm việc tối nay) ≈ ask someone to cover a work shift (nhờ ai đó làm thay một ca làm việc).

questions.stem: What is happening at the shop tonight?

options.text: Staff will work on new recipes.
Staff will offer free ice cream tastings.
Staff will participate in a training session.
Staff will hold a going-away party for a colleague.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: giving away samples (phát mẫu thử) ≈ offer free ice cream tastings (cung cấp các buổi nếm thử kem miễn phí).

questions.stem: Where is Ms. Chin going today?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: attending a birthday party (tham dự một bữa tiệc sinh nhật) ≈ To a party (Đến một bữa tiệc).

questions.stem: At 10:44 A.M., what does Mr. Stein most likely mean when he writes, “Well, I could really use the overtime hours”?

options.text: He is accepting Ms. Chin's apology.
He is declining Ms. Chin’s offer.
He enjoys working at the shop.
He prefers to work in the evening.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: I could really use the overtime hours (Tôi thực sự cần số giờ làm thêm này) ≈ declining Ms. Chin’s offer (đang từ chối lời đề nghị của cô Chin - vì anh muốn làm thêm để lấy lương).

questions.stem: Why did Ms. Najjar most likely prepare the report?

options.text: To explain why the mixing equipment is not working properly
To document findings of a factory inspection
To explain why productivity has recently decreased
To justify the purchase of new rotating drums

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: completed my inspection (hoàn thành việc kiểm tra) ≈ document findings of a factory inspection (ghi chép lại các kết quả của một đợt kiểm tra nhà máy).

questions.stem: What is true about the tire molds?

options.text: There is a separate section about them in the report.
They have all been replaced recently.
They are not produced within the factory.
More tires can now be produced with fewer molds.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: section dedicated to tire molds (phần dành riêng cho khuôn lốp xe) ≈ separate section about them in the report (có một phần riêng về chúng trong báo cáo).

questions.stem: What is indicated about the Kiame Tire Factory?

options.text: Most of its equipment is old.
It is less expensive to maintain than anticipated.
It is likely to grow in the future.
It has recently lost several employees.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: increases its production (tăng sản lượng) ≈ likely to grow in the future (có khả năng sẽ phát triển trong tương lai).

questions.stem: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? “Of course, replacing existing models would be more costly.''
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Of course, replacing... would be more costly (Tất nhiên, việc thay thế sẽ tốn kém hơn) ≈ bổ sung ý nghĩa so sánh chi phí cho các phương án đã nêu ở câu trước.

questions.stem: What does the announcement indicate about the award?

options.text: Its winner is chosen by Mr. Young.
Its focus is on making cities smaller.
It is given out every year.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Annual (thường niên/hàng năm) ≈ every year (mỗi năm).

questions.stem: According to the announcement, what is required of candidates for the competition?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: completes a project (hoàn thành một dự án) ≈ Completion of a building project (Hoàn thành một dự án xây dựng).

questions.stem: According to the article, what is true about Ms. Rahotu?

options.text: She served on the LNZB selection panel.
She recently moved to the region.
She specializes in designing apartment buildings.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: work... goes back many years (làm việc... từ nhiều năm trước) ≈ significant design experience (kinh nghiệm thiết kế đáng kể).

questions.stem: What will Ms. Rahotu do in April?

options.text: Become the head of the LNZB
Lead a tour of a building
Submit an entry in a competition

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: show guests... around the finished building (dẫn khách tham quan tòa nhà) ≈ Lead a tour of a building (Dẫn đầu một chuyến tham quan tòa nhà).

questions.stem: According to the article, why is Ms. Rahotu’s design exceptional?

options.text: It uses a high percentage of recycled materials.
It produces a large amount of electricity.
Its roof and walls have curved shapes.
It has a garden that covers most of the roof.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: generates a high surplus of electricity (tạo ra một lượng điện dư thừa lớn) ≈ produces a large amount of electricity (sản xuất một lượng lớn điện năng).

questions.stem: What do the instructions describe?

options.text: How to display a piece of artwork
How to prepare a type of gourmet food
How to use a construction tool
How to take care of a piece of kitchen equipment

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: wash the product, cleaning (rửa sản phẩm, vệ sinh) ≈ take care of a piece of kitchen equipment (chăm sóc một món dụng cụ nhà bếp).

questions.stem: According to the instructions, what can oil be used for?

options.text: To make a product taste better
To make a product look better
To make a product run faster

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: help colors stay bright (giúp màu sắc luôn tươi sáng) ≈ make a product look better (làm cho sản phẩm trông đẹp hơn).

questions.stem: What was Mr. Iversen most likely about to do when he noticed a problem?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: remove strap before cleaning (tháo dây trước khi vệ sinh) ≈ Clean the product (Vệ sinh sản phẩm).

questions.stem: How long has Mr. Iversen owned the product?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: purchased... four months ago (đã mua... 4 tháng trước) ≈ For four months (Được bốn tháng).

questions.stem: What does Mr. Iversen ask Lazon Products to do?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: I'd like to get a new one [strap] (tôi muốn lấy cái [dây] mới) ≈ Send a replacement part (Gửi một bộ phận thay thế).

questions.stem: What can guests do at Fluttering Wings Resort?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: bird-watching (ngắm chim) ≈ Observe birds (quan sát chim).

questions.stem: According to the e-mail, in what way can ITIA help Fluttering Wings Resort?

options.text: By teaching employees how to raise butterflies
By helping the resort improve its online advertising effort
By providing the resort with new laptop computers

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: use the Web to promote services (sử dụng Web để quảng bá dịch vụ) ≈ improve its online advertising effort (cải thiện nỗ lực quảng cáo trực tuyến).

questions.stem: What resort activity will Ms. Del Vio be unable to do during her visit?

options.text: Tour the local villages in an electric vehicle
Visit a sanctuary while millions of butterflies are there

questions.explanation:
Dẫn chứng 1: "Butterfly season is from mid-November to early March..." (Mùa bướm là từ giữa tháng 11 đến đầu tháng 3...).
Dẫn chứng 2: "...Rosa Del Vio... would like to... visit your resort in July or August." (...Rosa Del Vio... muốn... đến thăm khu nghỉ dưỡng của bạn vào tháng 7 hoặc tháng 8).
Paraphrase: visit in July/August (thăm vào tháng 7/8) ≠ Butterfly season (mùa bướm) ≈ Visit a sanctuary while millions of butterflies are there (Tham quan khu bảo tồn khi có hàng triệu con bướm ở đó).

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the note on the receipt?

options.text: To reassure the Bardoms about the timing of their trip
To explain why the bill included an extra charge
To thank the Bardoms for visiting a resort
To warn the Bardoms of a possible disappointment

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Regarding your question, don't worry (Liên quan đến câu hỏi của ông bà, đừng lo lắng) ≈ reassure the Bardoms about the timing of their trip (trấn an nhà Bardom về thời điểm chuyến đi của họ).

questions.stem: How will the Bardoms most likely tour the. butterfly sanctuary?
questions.explanation:
Dẫn chứng 1 (VB1): "Visitors can hike... but most prefer to participate in our guided horseback tours." (Du khách có thể đi bộ... nhưng hầu hết thích tham gia các tour cưỡi ngựa có hướng dẫn của chúng tôi).
Dẫn chứng 2 (VB3): Hóa đơn của nhà Bardom có mục "Guided butterfly sanctuary tour" (Tour tham quan khu bảo tồn bướm có hướng dẫn).
Paraphrase: guided tour → prefer horseback (thích cưỡi ngựa) ≈ On horseback (Bằng cách cưỡi ngựa).

questions.stem: What does the advertisement indicate?

options.text: The number of student discounts is limited.
The conference will last for fifteen days.
Free busing from hotels is available.
The conference center is being renovated.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: complimentary bus service (dịch vụ xe buýt miễn phí) ≈ Free busing (việc đi lại bằng xe buýt miễn phí).

questions.stem: Where did Mr. Brewster and Mr. Bax most likely meet?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: meeting after a speech in London (gặp mặt sau bài phát biểu tại London) ≈ At a conference (tại một hội nghị).

questions.stem: In the first e-mail, what does Mr. Brewster say he will do?

options.text: Include someone else in a meeting

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: ask project manager to join us (yêu cầu quản lý dự án tham gia cùng) ≈ Include someone else in a meeting (mời thêm người khác vào cuộc họp).

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the second e-mail?

options.text: To ask Mr. Brewster to send a shipment
To discuss the status of an order
To complain about the quality of a product

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: delay shipments/fast-track order (trì hoãn chuyến hàng/đẩy nhanh đơn hàng) ≈ discuss the status of an order (thảo luận tình trạng của một đơn hàng).

questions.stem: What is suggested about Mr. Brewster?

options.text: He owns farmland in both the United Kingdom and Bulgaria.
He wants to start a new business with Mr. Bax.
He developed a new agricultural product.
He ordered lights for some indoor plants.

questions.explanation:
Dẫn chứng 1: "Ms. Ko has some questions about lighting for my greenhouses." (Cô Ko có một số câu hỏi về hệ thống chiếu sáng cho các nhà kính của tôi).
Dẫn chứng 2: "We received the request and the design specifications from you... begin production." (Chúng tôi đã nhận được yêu cầu và các thông số kỹ thuật thiết kế từ ông... bắt đầu sản xuất).
Paraphrase: lighting for greenhouses + design specs received for production ≈ ordered lights for some indoor plants (đã đặt mua đèn cho một số cây trồng trong nhà).

questions.stem: According to the advertisement, what is indicated about Orange Light Gym’s Orchard Road location?

options.text: It is Orange Light Gym’s only location with a pool.
It is the first Orange Light Gym in Singapore.
It is owned by a famous bodybuilder.
It offers classes led by a popular trainer.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: first location in Singapore (địa điểm đầu tiên tại Singapore) ≈ first Orange Light Gym in Singapore.

questions.stem: What does Mr. Halle indicate about the Orange Light Gym Marina South location?

options.text: It has more machines than the Orchard Road location.
It is smaller than the Orchard Road location.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: compared to much larger Orchard Road (so với Orchard Road lớn hơn nhiều) ≈ smaller than the Orchard Road location (nhỏ hơn địa điểm Orchard Road).

questions.stem: What is true about Mr. Halle’s membership in the Orange Light Gym?

options.text: He never used it to enter the Dubai location.
He started it before locations opened in Singapore.

questions.explanation:
Dẫn chứng 1: "I have been a regular Orange Light Gym member for ten years..." (Tôi đã là thành viên thường xuyên của Orange Light Gym được mười năm).
Dẫn chứng 2: "Orange Light Gym is coming to Singapore! ... open our newest and best gym in April. This will be our first location in Singapore..." (Orange Light Gym sắp đến Singapore! ... khai trương phòng tập mới nhất và tốt nhất vào tháng Tư. Đây sẽ là địa điểm đầu tiên của chúng tôi tại Singapore...).
Paraphrase: member for 10 years + Singapore first opened in April this year ≈ started before locations opened in Singapore (bắt đầu trước khi các địa điểm ở Singapore mở cửa).

questions.stem: Why did Ms. Wayanti send the e-mail?

options.text: To express concern about a hired company’s poor work
To ask about becoming a gym member

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: concerned about improper maintenance by workers ≈ express concern about a hired company’s poor work (bày tỏ lo ngại về công việc kém chất lượng của một công ty được thuê).

questions.stem: What is suggested about Stokner Service?

options.text: It services Orange Light Gym locations in Dubai.
It fixes the exercise machines at Orange Light Gyms in Singapore.
It is not maintaining the pools at Orange Light Gyms well.
It was recently bought by another company.

questions.explanation:
Dẫn chứng 1: "the pool was not available for use... hope they address the cause of the pool closures." (hồ bơi không thể sử dụng... hy vọng họ giải quyết nguyên nhân gây ra việc đóng cửa hồ bơi).
Dẫn chứng 2: "The problems that we have had... are due to improper maintenance (by Stokner Service)." (Những vấn đề mà chúng ta gặp phải... là do bảo trì không đúng cách (bởi Dịch vụ Stokner)).
Paraphrase: pool closure due to improper maintenance by Stokner ≈ It is not maintaining the pools at Orange Light Gyms well (Nó không bảo trì tốt các hồ bơi tại Orange Light Gyms).
